desc: Parse input; derive potential model (l=min(S,T), r=max, up iff S<T; P[l]=P[r]; every interior strictly > P[l] for up, < P[l] for down).

Establish pairwise conflict conditions (same l, same r, or same-direction proper crossing) and implement O((M+Q) log M) solution (stable-sort same-l/same-r; region A/B segment trees + per-leaf heaps; nc[i]; suffix-min answering).
Confirm both public samples pass through the normal path (Yes/No; No/Yes/Yes).
Run the embedded stress harness and report the exact output line (ok counts, or mismatch with person list/range).
If PAIRWISE MISMATCH is reported: the pairwise criterion is insufficient — revisit the whole reduction and re-derive the feasible-set characterization, then rebuild the solver.
If FAST MISMATCH is reported: debug the crossing sweep / suffix-min against the reported person set and range, then re-run stress.
Once stress is clean, benchmark at N,M,Q ≈ 2e5 to confirm runtime is acceptable and cut constant factors if needed.
